label: The piece ' Ste' at the start of a surname, where the tokenizer splits it off, usually after a first name or title (Tom Steyer, Dr. Stecher, Jan Stepanovic, Ruth Steiner, Andreas Steinhofel); quiet for lowercase ste- words (steep, steady, steam), for surnames read whole or split as ' St' (Stein, Steven, Stewart, Stenger, Stelter), for places like Sault Ste. Marie, and for other surnames. Side case: the capitalized first word of Kurosawa's film title High and Low also fires.
